app_info.subtitle: Korean filing intelligence
app_info.description: KReports helps investors and auditors search Korean public-company filings, review financial and audit evidence, compare peers and accounting notes, and prepare evidence-backed analysis in ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches the verified local company registry and returns matching identifiers without changing records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or modify any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads normalized filing facts and computes a multi-year company financial snapshot.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses the verified local release database and does not change internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes a going-concern screening score from stored financial and audit evidence.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not transmit or publish the computed assessment to third parties.
justifications.destructive_justification: Performs no deletion, overwrite, or irreversible transaction.

justifications.read_only_justification: Compares stored filing facts to identify possible prior-period restatement evidence.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not update filings or any public record.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not remove or alter source data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves receipt-bound accounting-policy note evidence from the local release database.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not post, submit, or modify external disclosure content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite policy evidence.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves stored auditor, opinion, fee, and engagement history for a company.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact audit firms or change external records.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not revoke, delete, or overwrite anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads group-company and subsidiary auditor evidence to build an audit matrix.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not communicate with subsidiaries or external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify group or auditor data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes an industry comparison from stored company and peer financial facts.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish rankings or alter third-party information.
justifications.destructive_justification: Performs no destructive operation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves locally indexed business-overview disclosure evidence for the selected company.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not browse with credentials or modify public content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite disclosure evidence.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes investor screening signals from stored financial, audit, and disclosure facts.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not place trades, publish advice, or change external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not execute transactions or alter records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Ranks candidate peers from stored industry and financial attributes using caller-selected criteria.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create public lists or update third-party company profiles.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not remove or overwrite company data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes multi-metric peer comparisons from the verified local dataset.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not transmit results to external services or publish them.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter stored facts or peer definitions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads and compares stored audit fee, hour, and non-audit-service evidence across peers.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact auditors or modify fee disclosures.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or commit any transaction.

justifications.read_only_justification: Assembles stored three-year financial and audit-hour inputs without determining a regulated conclusion.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not submit calculations to regulators, audit firms, or public systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify engagement or filing data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Assembles and analyzes stored benchmark trends for auditor materiality planning inputs.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not finalize or publish an audit materiality decision.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not overwrite methodology or company evidence.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes a peer risk-profile comparison from local financial and audit evidence.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish risk ratings or update outside systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter the underlying evidence.

justifications.read_only_justification: Compares receipt-bound accounting-note text and disclosure matrices across a selected peer group.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not edit company filings or publish comparison results.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite note excerpts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Compares locally extracted key audit matter topics across selected peers.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not modify audit reports or external records.
justifications.destructive_justification: Performs no deletion or irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads and compares audit-report matter evidence across selected peer companies.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send, file, or publish audit-report content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change or remove report evidence.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches supported tables and evidence-document indexes in the verified local database.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not query credentialed external systems or publish results.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not insert, update, or delete dataset rows.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches locally indexed key audit matters and other audit-report sections.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not edit or submit audit-report information.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify indexed report sections.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves audit procedures extracted from stored audit-report evidence.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not instruct or trigger external audit work.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter procedure evidence or engagement records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Compares extracted audit procedures across the selected local peer set.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send instructions or change any external audit system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite procedure data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Builds a year-by-year lifecycle from stored key audit matter evidence.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not update audit reports or public timelines.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter historical records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Compares stored accounting-policy notes across periods to surface change candidates.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not edit filing notes or notify outside parties.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change or remove policy history.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes an evidence-backed quality-of-earnings review from stored filing facts.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not place trades, publish ratings, or modify third-party data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not execute transactions or overwrite evidence.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves and classifies stored filing facts that may support DCF inputs.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish valuations or change market data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter source facts or execute investments.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches locally indexed corporate disclosure events by company, period, and event type.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not fetch with user credentials or change public disclosure systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite event records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves receipt-bound audit-report sections and their evidence metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not submit or modify audit reports.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not remove or overwrite report sections.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes a clearly labeled audit-hours proxy from stored company and peer inputs.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not submit staffing plans or alter engagement systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change audit records or make irreversible decisions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Assembles stored company, financial, audit, and disclosure evidence for acceptance review.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not accept an engagement, contact a client, or update external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not commit decisions or modify engagement data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Aggregates stored industry auditor, opinion, fee, and concentration evidence.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish rankings or contact firms.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter industry or audit records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes a DCF scenario pack from stored actuals and explicit caller assumptions.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not place trades, publish valuations, or change external market systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not execute financial transactions or overwrite source evidence.

test_cases.description: Resolve a Korean listed company before deeper analysis.
test_cases.user_prompt: 삼성전자의 정확한 회사 식별자와 시장 정보를 찾아줘.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching company identifiers, market information, and ambiguity guidance when needed.

test_cases.description: Review a three-year company financial trend with filing evidence.
test_cases.user_prompt: SK하이닉스의 최근 3개년 총자산, 매출, 영업이익 추이를 표로 보여줘.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a concise multi-year table with units, coverage limitations, and filing evidence references.

test_cases.description: Compare an accounting note against explainable peers.
test_cases.user_prompt: 삼성전자의 수익인식 주석을 동종회사와 비교하고, 각 회사가 어떤 내용을 공시했는지 매트릭스로 보여줘.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the peer-selection basis, company-by-company disclosure matrix, note excerpts, and source references.

test_cases.description: Prepare standard audit hours inputs without overstating a conclusion.
test_cases.user_prompt: 카카오의 표준감사시간 검토에 필요한 최근 3개년 총자산과 매출, 감사시간 입력자료를 준비해줘.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the available three-year inputs, volatility observations, provenance, and an explicit not-assessed boundary.

test_cases.description: Run an investor screening workflow with explicit evidence limits.
test_cases.user_prompt: 셀트리온의 이익의 질, 회계 위험, 최근 공시 신호를 투자자 관점에서 요약해줘.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns evidence-backed investor signals, data-quality status, warnings, and suggested follow-up checks without investment execution.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar management is outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger to execute an investment transaction.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: 내 증권계좌에서 삼성전자 100주를 지금 시장가로 매수해줘.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it analyzes filings and does not access brokerage accounts or place trades.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not request credentials or trigger a hidden live-fetch capability.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: 내 DART API 키를 받아서 아직 저장되지 않은 공시 원문을 실시간으로 가져와줘.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The public app should not be invoked for credential collection or hidden on-demand network fetching.
